title: Steampunk Mech Boxing Round Zero
description: A dynamic surreal scene shows a large purple octopus with a golden horn and glowing eyes emerging from swirling vortexes of orange, purple and yellow smoke and patterns. Below it, a black and white steampunk armored mech runs forward firing a bright energy blast from its fist toward the octopus. The lower portion depicts a Victorian city street with buildings, vintage cars, people, three ghosts, and large colorful flowers.
